label: Embodied first person
camera_rules: The camera belongs to one character body and moves only through that body.
Visible limbs, breath, balance, and contact belong to the camera owner.
Looking into the lens means looking toward the camera owner.
continuity_rules: Do not use detached orbit, crane, or external tracking motion.
Preserve camera-owner limb ownership and current body state.
External views of the owner require a real reflection, display, or a separate shot.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
